sources.title: DeepSeek V4 Flash EXL3 K2 on one DGX Spark - GitHub
sources.snippet: The model knows how to address 1,048,576 positions, and the default recipe exposes a 1,000,000-token request limit at gpu_memory_utilization=0.85. The KV cache is a real pool, not a million-token tribute collected from every request at the door.
